open_items: No analyzed arm counts or factorial-cell counts are printed. Counts of people randomized are not established by counts completing the surveys. All n_randomized and arm-count fields remain null.
Experiment 2A: the pairwise tests use the three-arm model, but the participant total for either two-arm comparison is unprinted; n_total is null for those estimates.

Experiment 2B: the error term and printed d may incorporate variance from model-only responses. Pure two-human-arm uncertainty and the d standardizer are not printed. The form-derived complete model observation count is not transcribed into n_units because it is not printed.
Experiment 2B: the Reporting Summary gives a survey completion count larger than the analyzed sample but omits an explicit experiment-specific exclusion count; no subtraction is performed.

No release year for the AI model is printed, so ai_tool.year is null. The abstract names GPT-3.5; Experiment 2B reports that most assisted participants used it, rather than enforcing a single model version for every person.

The primary outcome of the preregistrations is not stated in the supplied paper. Preregistration exists for Experiments 2A, 2B, 4 and 5; status for Experiments 1 and 3 is not stated. Preregistered_primary remains not_stated.

Supplementary Notes E–I are not in the available local paper. Missing results include sub-dimension arm summaries, expert ratings not reproduced in the main text, the top-ranked creativity share definition and statistics, and the newness-type analysis.

Experiment 1 fluency: the direction of the printed t/d cannot be established from absent arm means, and the t/P pair is flagged as inconsistent in the reconciled screening form. Values are preserved without correction.

Experiments 4 and 5: no separately confirmed lay-rating contrast pooling both levels of the second factor is printed. The claimed technology main effects match particular simple contrasts according to the reconciled form; they are not treated as additional independent estimates.
The paper does not define the denominator used for its reported Cohen d values. It must not be assumed to be a two-arm pooled participant SD, particularly in multi-arm models.
Expert creativity arm means are absent in Experiment 2A, and expert arm SDs are absent in Experiment 2B. No arm means or SDs are given for Experiment 1 originality, appropriateness, or fluency.
Experiment 1 top-ranked creativity share has only a direction, no threshold, denominator, arm percentages or uncertainty. It remains an outcome record with null numerical statistics.
Figure 1 labels the total-effect coefficient beta without explicitly naming its scale; regression.outcome_scale is null rather than assuming raw or standardized units.
notes: Extracted independently by B on 2026-10-09. Read all 522 lines of the markdown conversion, including references, back matter and the Reporting Summary. Read the twelve PDF pages with pymupdf; checked Table 1 with find_tables and Figure 1 from its printed text. Only the named extraction file was written. No statistics, sample counts, SDs, differences or uncertainty were calculated from data, degrees of freedom, p-values, graphs, or other printed quantities. Source quotes are taken directly from PDF text or table cells, with whitespace normalized; their original numeric precision and Unicode signs are preserved. Scientific-notation values are stored as JSON numbers; source quotes retain the printed notation and trailing zeros. Cohen d CIs occupy paper_effect and, unless a separate total-effect coefficient CI is available, the general CI fields identified as paper_effect. S4-O1 also retains the numerically labelled total-effect path in Figure 1; no values were estimated visually. The randomized constraint and empathy cells are treated as distinct arms: complete comparisons of those arms are included, while interactions, moderator main effects and participant-defined subgroup/associational analyses are excluded. Counts of raters, model responses and survey completions are not substituted for analyzed people. The source paper reports only outcomes with AI available, with no across-person diversity or post-AI outcome. The screening form identifies shared samples with c015; that linkage is carried over without importing c015 statistics. No separate local Supplementary Notes file was found, and no external data or preregistration document was used to fill unprinted values.
